scope: Sprint 4 local staff progression/delegation validation; device and store release gates remain Sprint 15

source.manifest_algorithm: sorted Git-listed existing runtime/assets/test/tool paths, UTF-8 path TAB SHA256 LF; documentation excluded

coverage.input: ScreenTouch/ScreenDrag via Input.parse_input_event and viewport GUI; native touchscreen emulation for ScrollContainer

regression_harness.change: SceneTree entry point loads RefCounted cases at runtime and releases the instance before quit; all original case bodies are preserved exactly. Ten isolated native runs, the full native suite and strict gda run exited cleanly. Engine-internal root cause was not established with a native stack trace.
regression_harness.audio: Bounded two-second wait for exact pre-playback resource reference count; synchronous helper prevents polling expression from retaining its own resource across await. Playback/player-release/reference-equality assertions retained.
regression_harness.gates: Nonzero exit status, assertions, script errors and shutdown leaks remain failures; no retries or ignored crashes in the passing full run.

visual_review.observations: Profile price/performance and employee progression precede long explanations/portraits; content scrolls in the context panel, confirmation blocks world/navigation input, and departure removes staff/wage. Existing original staff art reused; no new icon system.

balance.policy: Build reception/bedroom/restaurant; cover reception and cleanup manually. Delegated case hires both essential roles from earned Cash while retaining one upcoming hotel-day of wages/maintenance.
balance.limitations: Deterministic policy measurements; not proof of human comprehension, enjoyment or retention.
